fallbackOrder: quest optimized GLB plus KTX2 textures
quest optimized GLB plus WebP textures

fireflies.runtimePolicy: Use a single ShaderMaterial Points draw call with circular radial glow in-shader. Quest uses 720 fireflies and high quality uses 960; reduce draw range under reducedParticles.

atmosphere.runtimePolicy: Use procedural shader horizon mist and Three.FogExp2 only. Low coherence uses denser midnight-teal fog; high coherence softens density and shifts toward a quiet violet/lavender horizon.

grass.runtimePolicy: Use a procedural hyperreal lawn over a textured plain ground for full coverage. Use Animated+Grass.glb and Animated+Grass.obj as small near-field accent geometry sources, Animated+Grass.fbx as the compatible animation source, and Animated+Grass.blend as the editable master source.

bushes.highOnlyReason: bush3.glb is about 50 MB and over 1M triangles, so Quest loads it only with quality=high or heavyBushes=1.

organicGroundDetails.questRuntimePolicy: Load rocks, cherry_petals2, lavender, chamomile, and glowing_plants by default. cherry_petals1 is high quality or heavyDecor=1 because it is about 20 MB.

sanctuaryBorder.runtimePolicy: Use pine_tree1.glb and pine_tree2.glb as shared dense distant sources plus many overlapping hill.glb clones as a continuous hill range with procedural fallback. All pines use the same subtle green tint. Hill clones are lifted, widened, and placed closer to remain visible above the grass horizon.

sakuraBlossoms.coherenceBehavior: High coherence increases pale pink/white blossom lift, subtle emissive warmth, and fuller draw range; low coherence shifts gradually toward amber/dry petals with smoother thinning.

grassGlbField.rendererPath: InstancedMesh procedural blade clumps plus generated ground color/bump textures, GLB/OBJ near-field accent meshes, FBX animation extraction, and MeshStandardMaterial.onBeforeCompile wind shader
grassGlbField.coverage: A plain circular ground uses generated grass albedo/bump textures for continuous coverage, while an ultra-dense jittered-grid field covers the full visible ground with overlapping upright clumps: roughly 246k visible clumps on Quest and 418k on high quality. Animated+Grass.glb and Animated+Grass.obj are used only as small accent geometry, not tiled as terrain, because full-field tiling produced warped flat carpet artifacts.
grassGlbField.fallback: If source GLB/OBJ/FBX assets are unavailable, the procedural lawn and plain textured ground still render.
grassGlbField.comfortBehavior: reducedMotion lowers grass shader wind strength and extracted FBX clip mixer speed.

bushAccents.rendererPath: Grounded cloned GLB accents with material tinting, texture anisotropy, alpha test, and subtle coherence-driven emissive bloom.
bushAccents.placement: Twenty-five deterministic clusters placed around the clearing and distant grass edges while keeping the tree and control panels unobstructed.

organicGroundDetails.rendererPath: Grounded cloned GLB accents with cloned/tinted PBR materials, alpha test, and subtle coherence-driven emissive lift for flowers/glowing plants.
organicGroundDetails.placement: Mossy rocks sit around the sakura base and meadow edges; cherry petal patches sit under the canopy; lavender, chamomile, and glowing plants sit in deterministic meadow patches away from the VR controls.

sanctuaryBorder.rendererPath: Shared GLB pine clones with a consistent green fog-reactive matte material plus a dense lifted/scaled belt of hill.glb clones.
sanctuaryBorder.placement: Pines are distributed in a dense deterministic multi-depth ring roughly 32m-47m from the clearing center so they overlap slightly; hill clones sit closer as a continuous range beneath and between the pine silhouettes.

atmosphere.rendererPath: Procedural sky shader horizon mist plus Three.FogExp2.
atmosphere.coherenceBehavior: Low coherence keeps the horizon darker and fog denser; higher coherence gradually reduces density and warms the horizon toward muted violet/lavender while preserving the midnight scene.

firefliesAndStars.rendererPath: Procedural star ShaderMaterial plus firefly ShaderMaterial point sprites.
firefliesAndStars.behavior: Stars twinkle with slow per-star phase offsets. Fireflies use warm circular glow sprites, Brownian-style drift around the sakura, and inhale-synchronized brightness.

acceptanceChecklist: Cold-load the scene in Quest Browser and confirm assetStatus reaches ready or fallback without a blank scene.
Enter VR and confirm controller hover/click still works on Start, Pause, Resume, Stop, comfort toggles, Recenter, and Sweep.
Run at least five minutes in quality=quest and confirm the scene feels stable at the headset refresh rate.
Confirm default Quest sky uses the procedural twinkling-star path and does not load the optimized or source sky assets by default.
Sustain high and low demo/live coherence and confirm sakura blossoming/withering stays gradual.
Toggle reducedMotion, reducedParticles, highContrastGuide, and largerText with no overlapping panels.

generationNotes: GLBs generated with glTF Transform optimize using meshopt and WebP texture compression.
KTX2 texture variants generated with basis_universal from WebP-derived PNG intermediates.

The active Quest sky is procedural: a plain dark sky dome plus thousands of shader-twinkled star points. night_sky_quest.glb, nightsky_quest.webp, and sky_gradient.webp are source/reference fallbacks only.
sakura_ground_ao.webp and sakura_canopy_shadow.webp are source/reference only in the current plain-ground runtime.
Phase 4 upgrades the sakura blossom material with PBR-preserving shader hooks and deterministic per-vertex blossom variation.
Phase 5 adds debug-only Quest profiling for load time, active LOD, sky profile, draw calls, triangles, texture counts, frame timing, and slow-frame hints.

Grass runtime now uses a generated textured ground plus dense procedural instanced clumps for a natural plain lawn. Animated+Grass.glb and Animated+Grass.obj add near-field accent geometry, Animated+Grass.fbx is used for compatible accent animation extraction, and Animated+Grass.blend remains the editable source.
Botanical ground accents use bush1, bush2, bush4, and bush5 by default on Quest; bush3 is available in high quality or with heavyBushes=1 because it is substantially heavier.

Phase 4 adds organic ground details from rock1, rock2, rock3, rock_pack, cherry_petals1/2, lavender, chamomile, and glowing_plants without removing the existing grass, bushes, pines, hills, fireflies, or stars.
The sanctuary border uses pine_tree1 and pine_tree2 as dense distant forest silhouettes with hill.glb-backed hills to hide the flat horizon.
Phase 2 of the environmental sanctuary upgrade blends the horizon with procedural sky mist and coherence-linked FogExp2 density/color, with no additional runtime assets.
Phase 3 replaces square/flat firefly points with warm radial shader sprites, slow Brownian drift, inhale-linked glow, slower per-star twinkling, 9000/14000 procedural stars, and 720/960 fireflies.

notes: Phase 2 generated optimized assets and runtime decoders. Phase 3 adds runtime LOD switching. Phase 4 improves blossom material quality while preserving source fallbacks. Phase 5 adds runtime Quest profiling and the final manual acceptance checklist. The current scene uses a plain visible textured ground, dense procedural grass blades, deterministic bush accents from assets/new/bush1-5, organic rock/petal/flower/glowing-plant details from assets/new, a dense distant pine-and-hill sanctuary border from assets/new/pine_tree1, pine_tree2, and hill.glb, coherence-linked FogExp2 plus shader horizon mist to soften the field/sky boundary, warm bioluminescent firefly shader sprites with breathing-linked glow, a higher-right moon loaded primarily from assets/new/Moon.fbx with assets/new/moon.glb as backup, an 8K moon surface texture, and a procedural twinkling-star sky instead of the night-sky GLB/texture layer.
